title: Verify: Scene art sources are PNG-sized, palette-only and match the committed manifest
summary: Unit tests for ART_SOURCES coverage, sizes, palette and manifest equality
description: Tests written from the requirement: coverage of ids, declared PNG sizes, palette-only pixels and committed manifest equality. No disk writes.
acceptance_criteria: Every required id is produced by generateAssets(ART_SOURCES)
Each generated PNG reads back its declared size and gridToRgba accepts every index
Committed manifest entries equal generated entries
technical_constraints: Unit tests only, no browser or server
definition_of_done: Test passes in under a few seconds

steps.action: Add tests. (1) ids test: generateAssets(ART_SOURCES).entries ids include all 13 ROOM_ART_SIZES names prefixed 'room/', 'character:boy-sheet', 'character:boy-portrait', 'objects/secret-door-open', 'effect:dust', 'ui/cursor-hand'. (2) size test: for each generated file, readPngSize(bytes) equals the entry dimensions; secret door is 32x64, dust 4x4. (3) palette test: gridToRgba(frame, PALETTE) does not throw for every frame of every source. (4) manifest test: import the committed manifest JSON from '../../public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json' and expect each generated entry toEqual the committed entry with the same id.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/sceneArtSources.test.ts
